scoring_justification: The main claim is a trend (Mn reduces barrier by >=0.2 eV). Full recompute of DFT barriers is infeasible in verifier; scoring checks ordering and barrier reduction from agent's reported barriers.

outputs.description: Computed migration barriers for Ni and Co atoms in Ni0.6Co0.2X0.2 (X=Co,Fe,Mn) alloys. The checker will compute per-alloy average barriers and evaluate structural trends.
Computed migration barriers for pure metals and their 80/20 metal-Mn binary alloys. The checker will compute per-system average barriers and evaluate structural trends.

output_contract.notes: The scoring is structural (T3): it evaluates relative ordering and magnitude differences of computed average barriers without requiring exact numeric agreement. The exact criteria are not disclosed.

steps.description: Verify that the average migration barrier for Ni0.6Co0.2Mn0.2 is lower than for Ni0.6Co0.2Co0.2 and Ni0.6Co0.2Fe0.2 by at least 0.2 eV.
Verify that for at least three metal pairs (pure vs 80%Mn binary) the average barrier in Mn alloy is lower by at least 0.2 eV.
